title: The same streamed operations as F43, logged in the opposite order
matrix: input, output, cache-read and cache-write breakdowns
policy: P9 streaming (decided on #58 re-review): an operation's cache writes are one quantity whose classification can change between its records. The larger quantity wins with its classification; a reclassification alone never adds tokens. At equal quantity the less certain wins (disputed > tier-unresolved > tiered), and two tier splits that disagree make the tier unresolved rather than picking one. The result, cost coverage included, doesn't depend on arrival order. Without a valid flat total, an invalid tier makes the valid tiers tier-unresolved (a minimum, not an exact price) and flags the message. F43 and F44 log the same records in opposite orders and must end equal.
derivation: Claude Haiku 4.5, each record [1, 1] (per million: input $1, output $5, 5m $1.25, 1h $2; a minimum uses $1.25). The five streamed operations end the same in either order: a 50+50 = 100 tiered and 30+30 != 100 are both 100, so the less certain wins: 100 unresolved (not 200). b 60+40 = 100 tiered vs flat 40 with 60+40: 40 unresolved, 60 disputed, both 100: the disputed one wins. c flat 100 vs 10+10: 100 unresolved; flat 20 vs 50+50: 20 unresolved, 80 disputed; both 100: the disputed one wins. d 50/50 and 30/70, both tiered 100: the splits disagree, so 100 unresolved (neither split is priced). e flat 100 vs 200+100: 100 unresolved, 200 disputed (300); 350 = 350+0: 5m 350; 350 > 300 wins, +50 over the larger record, not +350. f no flat, 5m "x", 1h 25: 25 unresolved, flawed. g flat 25, 5m "x", 1h 25: 25 unresolved, flawed. p: msg_p alone and req_p alone are two incomplete operations until the pair arrives (#55), which takes over the message-only one and merges the request-only one: tiered 50/50 and unresolved 100 are both 100, so 100 unresolved; the pair's own 50/50 changes nothing. Final: 8 operations [8, 8, 5m 350, 0, 0, 8], unresolved 100+40+20+100+25+25+100 = 410, disputed 60+80 = 140; 16+350+410+140 = 916. Known 8 + 40 + 437.5 = 485.5 micro-dollars, minimum 410 x 1.25 = 512.5 micro-dollars, 140 disputed (provisional). Identity: a b c d e f g identified, p incomplete. Flawed f g. Before this fix the fields were maxed one by one: a counted 200, e 650, and the order changed the result. Step 1 (F43's second records first, msg_p unresolved, req_p tiered): 5m d30 e350 p50 = 430, 1h d70 p50 = 120, unresolved a100 b40 c20 f25 g25 p100 = 310, disputed b60 c80 = 140; 9 operations, 18+430+120+310+140 = 1018. Known 9 + 45 + 537.5 + 240 = 831.5, minimum 310 x 1.25 = 387.5 micro-dollars. Step 2 ends exactly as F43.
